query:
SELECT ci.characterName, ci.cardName, ci.tier, ci.estimatedValue, mc.imageUrl 
FROM checklist_items ci 
LEFT JOIN marvel_cards mc ON mc.characterName = ci.characterName 
WHERE ci.tier = 'chase' AND mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY ci.characterName 
ORDER BY ci.estimatedValue DESC 
LIMIT 12;
